name: Claude Code v2.1.317
hook: Today's release adds a privacy gate that asks before any web or shell tool sends your account email, `onFailure: "block"` for Agent SDK hook callbacks (the tool call now fails instead of silently proceeding), a `GET /v1/organizations/analytics/cost` endpoint in the gateway admin API, and link cards in cloud sessions. Also: `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_NESTED_SESSION_ID` for teams that need flat session trees. Small release, but the hook-failure and email-privacy changes affect all production agent setups.

name: REA — Reverse Engineer Anything
hook: 426k stars (updated Nov 3) — still the fastest-growing Claude Code plugin on GitHub. One MCP server + Claude Code plugin lets any coding agent reverse-engineer native binaries, Electron/JS apps, .NET assemblies, Android APKs, firmware, and packet captures fully locally. `npx rea-agents setup` auto-detects Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI, or Grok Build and wires the MCP server in one command.
recurring_note: ↑ Day 10 — 426k stars, still #1 claude-code topic by stars and still actively updated

name: Ponytail
hook: 184k stars (+3k since first featured Oct 31). Forces coding agents through a seven-rung pre-coding ladder before writing a line: is it needed, already in the codebase, in stdlib, a platform primitive, installed dep, or a one-liner? Benchmarks: 53% less code, 26% less cost, 45% fewer tokens vs. no skill. Adds `/ponytail-review`, `/ponytail-audit`, and a status band showing cost + code-reuse in real time.
recurring_note: ↑ Day 4 — 184k stars, +3k since Oct 31 first feature

name: UI UX Pro Max
hook: 145k stars. Design intelligence skill that gives Claude Code 79 searchable UI styles, 192 industry-matched color palettes, 74 Google Fonts pairings, 119 UX accessibility guidelines, and 22 tech stacks (React, Next.js, SwiftUI, Flutter, Jetpack Compose, and more). A `--persist` flag writes a `MASTER.md` brand file for consistency across sessions; a theme-migration command reskins existing apps to a chosen style.

name: ECC (Enhanced Coding Context)
hook: 296k stars, updated Nov 2. Comprehensive agent-harness performance overlay: 71 specialized agents, 314 on-demand skills, 98 slash-command shims, hooks-based session memory, and AgentShield security scanning (flags hardcoded secrets, permission misconfigs, MCP risks in your .claude/ directory). Works on Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, and Cursor. One setup command installs the whole stack.

name: Caveman
hook: 117k stars. Forces coding agents to reply in terse, caveman-style prose while leaving code and commands exact. Independent measurements: 33.2% fewer input tokens per session (own benchmark), 54% lower cost vs. Opus 5.5 at xhigh effort via smart routing, and 63.6% fewer response tokens in Elastic's MCP scenarios. Adobe Research independently confirmed 1.4–2.4× savings across 8 models. Apache-2.0.

name: CC Switch
hook: 152k stars. Cross-platform desktop app (macOS, Windows, Linux) for managing 12 AI coding tools — Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Grok Build, OpenCode, OpenClaw, Hermes, Pi, and more — from one GUI. Switch API providers in one click with 90+ presets; your plugins, hooks, and skills survive unchanged. Also manages MCP servers and shows a usage dashboard with quota tracking and cloud sync via WebDAV or S3.

name: Superpowers
hook: 311k stars, updated Nov 3. Composable software-development methodology for 16 coding agents including Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI, Hermes, Kimi Code, and Devin. Skills auto-trigger for clarifying questions, design docs, parallel subagents, and pre-ship review. October additions: Muse, Grok Build CLI, Kimi Code, Pi support, and a `diagnosing-superpowers` post-mortem skill.

name: Marketing Skills
hook: 58.3k stars. Fifty marketing skills for AI agents covering CRO (signup, onboarding, paywalls), copywriting, SEO (technical, AI-SEO, schema markup), paid ads, analytics, A/B testing, email, cold-email, growth, and RevOps. A `product-marketing` foundation skill injects product/audience/positioning context for all other skills to reference. Works with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Windsurf, and any Agent Skills host. MIT.

name: Scientific Agent Skills
hook: 56k stars (v2.72.0, updated Nov 2). 177 validated science skills covering biology, chemistry, medicine, physics, engineering, and Earth science — plus a Database Lookup skill for 80+ scientific databases. About 70 package-specific skills (RDKit, Scanpy, scikit-learn, and more) guide agents through domain-specific APIs without hallucinating function names. MIT; security scan results published in the repo.

name: Orca
hook: 114k stars. Desktop + mobile app for running multiple coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Pi) in parallel, each in its own git worktree. Design mode: click any UI element in an embedded Chromium view to send its HTML, CSS, and screenshot directly to the agent. SSH worktrees for remote machines, GitHub/Linear integration, mobile companion for monitoring and follow-up prompts. MIT.

name: Agent Skills (Addy Osmani)
hook: 113k stars. 25 production-grade skills by Addy Osmani (Chrome DevRel, author of Learning JavaScript Design Patterns) covering the full dev cycle: spec → plan → build → test → review → ship. Includes four specialist personas (code-reviewer, security-auditor, test-engineer, web-perf-auditor), 7 production checklists, and 9 slash commands. Works across Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Gemini CLI, Windsurf, Copilot, and OpenCode. MIT.

name: Graphify
hook: 142k stars. Parses code, docs, PDFs, images, and video into a traversable knowledge graph (no embeddings, no vector store) — each edge tagged EXTRACTED or INFERRED. Installs a `/graphify` skill and hooks that redirect file-search tool calls to the graph instead of grepping. Self-reported benchmarks: 0.497 recall@10 on LOCOMO and 76% QA accuracy on LongMemEval-S with zero LLM credits for graph building. ~40 languages.
install:
uv tool install graphifyy
graphify install

name: Planning With Files
hook: 27.9k stars. Manus-style working memory on disk: keeps `task_plan.md`, `findings.md`, and `progress.md` in your project so the plan survives `/clear`, context compaction, and crashes. Hooks re-inject selected planning context every turn. In gated mode, the agent's stop is held until all phases are ticked off. SHA-256 tamper attestation blocks injection if an approved plan is changed externally. Works with 60+ agents.

name: notebooklm-py
hook: 20.1k stars. Unofficial Python API, CLI, MCP server, and agent skill for Google's NotebookLM (now Gemini Notebook). Lets Claude Code agents add sources (URLs, YouTube videos, Drive files, pastes), trigger content generation (audio overviews, slide decks, quizzes, mind maps, infographics), and export artifacts (MP3, MP4, PDF, PNG, CSV, Markdown) without leaving the terminal. Auth via browser cookie import or master token.
